question: Did dental revenue grow from Q2 to Q3 2026? Show both quarters.
sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%q', inv_dt) = '2026-2' THEN tot_amt_c ELSE 0 END) AS q2_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%q', inv_dt) = '2026-3' THEN tot_amt_c ELSE 0 END) AS q3_revenue
FROM 
    inv_hdr
WHERE 
    inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' AND clinic_id = 'West'
